rules.gate: Every category requires energy above hull ≤ 0.1 eV/atom.
rules.structural: Verified: physical elastic data (0 < K_VRH ≤ 500, 0 < G_VRH ≤ 600 GPa) with G_VRH ≥ 25 GPa, element cost ≤ $100/kg and every element ≥ 10 ppm in Earth's crust. Inferred (no usable elastic data: none computed, or an unphysical fit): passes the structural-candidate rule. Metallic/alloy: band gap 0 and nonmetals < 50% of atoms; anything else is mineral/ceramic.
rules.structural_candidate: Never uses moduli. Within 0.05 eV/atom of the hull, element cost ≤ $100/kg, every element ≥ 10 ppm in Earth's crust, and either mineral/ceramic (band gap ≥ 3 eV, contains O) or metallic/alloy (metallic composition, only Al/Co/Cr/Cu/Fe/Mg/Mn/Mo/Nb/Ni/Sn/Ti/V/W/Zn/Zr plus B/C/N/Si, with at least one of Al/Cu/Fe/Mg/Ni/Ti).
rules.magnetic: FM or FiM ordering with net moment ≥ 0.5 μB per formula unit, and metallic or ferrimagnetic (insulating FM results are mostly artifacts of MP's ferromagnetic starting point).
rules.energy: Battery electrode: Li/Na/K/Mg/Zn ≥ 5% of atoms, a redox-active transition metal, an O/F/S/P/Se/N framework, no Rb/Cs/Ca/Sr/Ba, and within 0.05 eV/atom of the hull (any band gap); or PV absorber: band gap 1.0–1.8 eV.
rules.unclassified: Matches no rule above (or fails the energy-above-hull gate).
rules.priority: Primary category = first match in: structural metallic/alloy, magnetic, energy, structural mineral/ceramic, electronic/optical. Every other match is kept and listed in the detail card.

provenance.basis: entry order from the old numeric Materials Project ID
provenance.ml_origin_note: No public per-entry marker of ML-pipeline origin. GNoME-derived entries are the access-controlled gnome_r2scan_statics batch and are not in this atlas.

extrapolation.features: same standardized composition + property features as the map
